summary: Backend-only testing of the Excel-import email auto-detection fix (HRD payroll). Created /app/backend/tests/test_payroll_email_import.py with 13 tests covering all 6 requested email variations + 2 extra slip-sheet variants and the tolerant directory header, plus regression of gaji_trial.xlsx import, PDF 'T. Transport' and bulk-delete: 13/13 PASSED. Real-file check via GET /api/hrd/payslips?month=8&year=2026 shows all 5 slips have non-empty emails. One genuine edge-case defect found: any email text anywhere in a slip sheet (rows 6+, cols 1-14) overrides the correct per-employee directory email (reproduced: company footer 'Info: hrd@mitrakaryasarana.co.id' replaced the employee's real email).

critical.issue: Sheet-wide email scan in _parse_slip_sheet (rows 6..max_row, cols 1..14) takes the FIRST email found anywhere in the slip sheet and overrides the per-employee directory email (import_excel line ~1075 'if sheet_email'). Reproduced with test_payroll_email_footer_edge.py: directory email ivan.real@mks.co.id was replaced by a footer/company contact 'Info: hrd@mitrakaryasarana.co.id'. In real printed slips (company contact, 'Approved by: manager@...', HR contact) this silently assigns the SAME wrong email to every employee, so blast would send payslips to the wrong recipient (data-leak risk). Suggested fix: restrict scan to the employee info block (e.g. rows 6-12) and/or require a nearby 'email' label, and ignore a sheet email that is identical across multiple slip sheets / drop it when it does not match the employee's directory email.

minor.issue: tests/test_payroll_isolation.py: 1 failure + 4 errors because user 'nofia' does not exist (login 401). Per /app/memory/test_credentials.md nofia is only configured if already present, so this is stale test data, not a regression of this iteration.
Stored slip 'nama' keeps raw spacing (double spaces) — matching uses _nk() so import works, but the displayed/persisted name is not normalized via _clean_txt(). Cosmetic.

action_items: Fix sheet-wide email over-detection: do not let a company/footer email in a slip sheet override the employee's directory email (see backend_issues.critical). Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_payroll_email_footer_edge.py — it must pass.

/app/backend/routers/hrd.py is 1582 lines; parsing helpers (_extract_email/_cell_email/_parse_directory/_parse_slip_sheet) and PDF generation should be split into separate modules.
_extract_email/_clean_txt/_nk implementations are correct and reused consistently in _parse_directory and import_excel matching — good.

rca_of_the_issue: The reported bug (12 of ~100 emails not read) is fixed: _extract_email (regex + mailto + nbsp/zero-width cleanup), _cell_email (hyperlink fallback), _nk name normalization and the tolerant directory header (email/e-mail/mail) all verified end-to-end through the real API. Remaining risk is the opposite failure mode: _parse_slip_sheet scans the whole slip sheet for any email and import_excel gives it the highest priority, so a single non-employee email printed on the slip (company/HR contact, approver) silently overrides the correct per-employee email for every sheet.
